S.FORM: ingat pila bhgun sraran hga, pila lban/ pila' brbar baqun balay na ssquliq. qutux brbar nanak qu pila. thuyay maziy nniqun, glgan. ru baqun maziy ngasal uzi. te qsu balay hga, si giway p'iyuw qaya qu ssquliq. yan muya cikay guquh na squliq ru bih ngasal nha pmuhi cikah pngran . yasa baq p'iyuw pinbahuw qu lhga. muci qani lga, piyux llamu' nniqun ta kwara la. muci qani ga, ini' 'llaw uzi. m_yan muya piyux balay guquh na squliq. aki nyux mnglung 'myuw qutux hanray ki ppqlcing. ana ga, ini' soya pzyux guquh qu ppqlcing. hrhil qu llungun nya hiya. muci yasa lga, ini' baqi p'iyuw hga hiya lru. nanu yasa s'agal nha qaxa ru king, kong p'iyuw nqu ssquliq. nanu qani pila na qsu wayal. kincipoq balay qu king ru kong. iyat skongat nerang nya. yasa qu galan ta bbiran pila. aki nyux mosa lmosay twahiq ru ini' ga, pbaziy hmit na ngasal. iyat 'llaw hangal pzyux balay na king. nanu yasa kbalay pila lban / pila' brbar nha nanak qu qutux qutux qalang. galan nha pila bbiran na qalang. aki snhyun squliq kwara squ knalay sebu' nqu pila lban/ pila' brbar iyat msbah yan lxan brbar. qsu wayal na sebu' kbalay pila lban/ pila' brbar ga, si ga spngun nha snku squ king . ru kyalun sebu' qu ssquliq. ana knwan baqun mamu 'myuw pila lban qu king. 1971 kawas. krahu mrhuw na Amirika' Niksn kmal mha. kbalay pila Amirika' ana ini' spngi snku na king. iyat yugun pila Amirika' qu king. zyaw qani ini' khotaw snhi na ssquliq squ kbalay pila lban sebu'. nanu yasa snhyun ssquliq qu sebu'. baqun maziy nnanu qaya qu pila. snhyun ssquliq qu sebu' lga, snhyun nha balay qu krahu na ginko uzi. syakay na misuw. iyat ckaw pila lban/ pila' brbar nanak qu ssquliq. baq ckaw snhyun ggalan krryax uzi. snhyun ggalan ga " pila gomu" son nha. krangi' nha pila ckaw. baha hmswa snhyun na ssquliq qu bnrwan nqu ginko .
S.PHON: iŋat pila βħɣun [s|ɕ]raran ħɣa pila lβan pilaʔ βrβar βaqun βalaj na [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq qutux βrβar nanak qu pila tħujaj mazij nniqun ɣlɣan ru βaqun mazij ŋa[s|ɕ]al uzi te q[s|ɕ]u βalaj ħɣa [s|ɕ]i ɣiwaj pʔijuw qaja qu [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq jan muja [ʦ|ʨ]ikaj ɣuquħ na [s|ɕ]quliq ru βiħ ŋa[s|ɕ]al nħa pmuħi [ʦ|ʨ]ikaħ pŋran ja[s|ɕ]a βaq pʔijuw pinβaħuw qu lħɣa mu[ʦ|ʨ]i qani lɣa pijux llamuʔ nniqun ta kwara la mu[ʦ|ʨ]i qani ɣa iniʔ ʔllaw uzi məjan muja pijux βalaj ɣuquħ na [s|ɕ]quliq aki njux mŋluŋ ʔmjuw qutux ħanraj ki ppql[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ ana ɣa iniʔ [s|ɕ]oja pzjux ɣuquħ qu ppql[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ ħrħil qu lluŋun nja ħija mu[ʦ|ʨ]i ja[s|ɕ]a lɣa iniʔ βaqi pʔijuw ħɣa ħija lru nanu ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal nħa qaxa ru kiŋ koŋ pʔijuw nqu [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq nanu qani pila na q[s|ɕ]u wajal kin[ʦ|ʨ]ipoq βalaj qu kiŋ ru koŋ ijat [s|ɕ]koŋat neraŋ nja ja[s|ɕ]a qu ɣalan ta ββiran pila aki njux mo[s|ɕ]a lmo[s|ɕ]aj twaħiq ru iniʔ ɣa pβazij ħmit na ŋa[s|ɕ]al ijat ʔllaw ħaŋal pzjux βalaj na kiŋ nanu ja[s|ɕ]a kβalaj pila lβan pilaʔ βrβar nħa nanak qu qutux qutux qalaŋ ɣalan nħa pila ββiran na qalaŋ aki [s|ɕ]nħjun [s|ɕ]quliq kwara [s|ɕ]qu knalaj [s|ɕ]eβuʔ nqu pila lβan pilaʔ βrβar ijat m[s|ɕ]βaħ jan lxan βrβar q[s|ɕ]u wajal na [s|ɕ]eβuʔ kβalaj pila lβan pilaʔ βrβar ɣa [s|ɕ]i ɣa [s|ɕ]pŋun nħa [s|ɕ]nku [s|ɕ]qu kiŋ ru kjalun [s|ɕ]eβuʔ qu [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq ana knwan βaqun mamu ʔmjuw pila lβan qu kiŋ **** kawa[s|ɕ] kraħu mrħuw na amirikaʔ nik[s|ɕ]n kmal mħa kβalaj pila amirikaʔ ana iniʔ [s|ɕ]pŋi [s|ɕ]nku na kiŋ ijat juɣun pila amirikaʔ qu kiŋ zjaw qani iniʔ kħotaw [s|ɕ]nħi na [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq [s|ɕ]qu kβalaj pila lβan [s|ɕ]eβuʔ nanu ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]nħjun [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq qu [s|ɕ]eβuʔ βaqun mazij nnanu qaja qu pila [s|ɕ]nħjun [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq qu [s|ɕ]eβuʔ lɣa [s|ɕ]nħjun nħa βalaj qu kraħu na ɣinko uzi [s|ɕ]jakaj na mi[s|ɕ]uw ijat [ʦ|ʨ]kaw pila lβan pilaʔ βrβar nanak qu [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq βaq [ʦ|ʨ]kaw [s|ɕ]nħjun ɣɣalan krrjax uzi [s|ɕ]nħjun ɣɣalan ɣa pila ɣomu [s|ɕ]on nħa kraŋiʔ nħa pila [ʦ|ʨ]kaw βaħa ħm[s|ɕ]wa [s|ɕ]nħjun na [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq qu βnrwan nqu ɣinko
